change.title: Close the three high runtime recovery and finalize crash windows
change.summary: Adds an exact process-local Gateway terminal handoff into one-click, persists a typed prior-Science stop intent and outcome before and after the destructive stop boundary, and replaces cleanup-only success ordering with a replayable finalize intent that converts authority state before atomically committing the runtime binding and clearing the journal.

basis: the production one-click command retains the exact terminal interrupted-Gateway recovery record in a non-serializable affine handoff and the first one-click checkpoint accepts it only through complete-record comparison and CAS

ordinary one-click without that handoff still rejects every V2 record; target, transaction, phase, outcome, binding, prior-stop, finalize, and later-listener drift preserve the journal and fail closed

one-click persists a credential-free prior-stop recipe and typed intent before invoking the exact Science stop, then persists ExactStopped, NotStopped, or Unknown before any protected snapshot checkpoint

the success path persists a typed finalize action before converting the exact authority manifest to cleanup-only and atomically applies the binding plus journal clear only after authority prepare-success
an ActiveRecovery to CleanupOnly publication failure or final binding-journal commit failure preserves the prior binding plus exact finalize journal and never enters legacy compensation

handoff and finalize CAS the journal plus current active-profile and old-binding authority; replay accepts only a matching entry or empty cleanup-only manifest and preserves the journal on drift or a missing manifest
fresh replay covers both the ActiveRecovery-before-conversion and CleanupOnly-after-conversion crash windows without restoring protected state or deriving control flow from presentation text
post-stop infrastructure failures carry typed exact-runtime proof before AppState and durable ExactStopped publication

four registered Rust identities cover production paths, authority drift, missing manifests, both finalize faults, and fresh ActiveRecovery/CleanupOnly replay; source contracts bind finalize and the Desktop count
production normal and history prepare-publication and final config-writer failures each return degraded with the finalize journal intact and the next command replays before healthy reopen

exact candidate 9d7133285c32e8303cc47b6ff91b25e76dccec6f passed 15/15 source suites in run a3667a108442bfe2ba3ffe701fe6eea5; completion review found zero issues and rechecked all 30 leaf hashes and 507 snapshot entries
artifact, installed, live provider or Science, signing, notarization, public release, frontend history intent, and broader coordinator slicing are excluded
